content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is a white framed card of text only; the hero photo is pushed below the fold and then the sticky header overlaps the card in the full-page capture, while the contact section and footer repeat address and hours.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works with the arch photo and framed card, but the 'Ustvarjeno z UI' label on the small bouquet circle is clipped, the sticky header sits over the card, and the contact section plus footer repeat the same address, hours and note.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["On phone, bring the arch photo into the first screen (e.g. smaller card over the top of the photo, or photo above the card) instead of a text-only white box.","Remove the footer's 'Obiščite nas' and 'Delovni čas' blocks – the contact section directly above already carries the same address, hours and holiday note.","Shrink the giant '2010' numeral on desktop (it dominates a half-empty band) and align the about section so the heading isn't orphaned at the end of the hero slice."],"blockers":["Desktop and phone hero: the 'Ustvarjeno z UI' label on the small bouquet circle is clipped at the circle edge.","Phone and desktop: the sticky header overlaps the hero card content (headline/logo hidden) when scrolling.","Phone and desktop footer: address, directions link, opening hours and holiday note are repeated right below the contact section that already shows them."]}
